White Roses

Ernest Rhys (1859–1946)

N
O
 sleep like hers, no rest,
In all the earth to-night:
Upon her whiter breast
Our roses lie so light.
She had no sins to lose,
As some might say;
But calmly keeps her pale repose
Till God’s good day.
